comment: The Atlas tileset (TILESET.md): pieces generated as WMOs by kitwmo.py, shown as gameobjects (type 14) and
collided by the server through generated models (kitvmo.py). All share one doorway (8 x 7 yd, floor at z 0).
role 'piece' grows layouts; 'cap' closes the doorways a layout leaves open.
Reserved IDs: gameobject entries 900100-900199, displays 9900-9949, WMO ids 7900-7949.
